_about: Which of the team's photos goes where. scripts/import-site-photos.js reads this, makes web-sized copies in images/<stop-id>/, and replaces each listed stop's "images" in data/stops.json, in this order (the first is the site's hero). Source files come from the team's "VDC Site Photos" folder, named <site>_<order>_<description>. Captions and credits come from those file names; anything not in a file name is marked as needing confirmation. permission: "team" = the team's own photo; "pending" = publishing permission not yet confirmed (see docs/image-permissions.md).
